Class UDPReceiver

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.views.common.UDPReceiver
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
Direct Known Subclasses:
AnimatedAreaDisplayReceiver, BarChartsReceiver, HTMLStringReceiver, InteractionMessageReceiver, LineChartsReceiver, NeuralNetDisplayReceiver, ScatterPlotsReceiver, StateTransitionStringsReceiver, TimingDiagramsReceiver
public abstract class UDPReceiver extends Object implements Runnable
The UDPReceiver is a Runnable class that receive objects from UDPTransmitters via the User Datagram Protocol (UDP). This abstract class must be specialized (extended) to receive specific types of objects by overriding its receive() operation.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run()
      Run operation that simply receives a UDP datagram, streams the datagram's byte array into an object via an ObjectInputStream, and invokes the abstract operation to receive(Object) to process the received object. It continues this activity until an indication that the reception is done is received from the receive(Object) operation.
      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable

    • receive

      public abstract boolean receive(Object data)
      Receives the specified data object received via UDP. Overrides of this operation should translate (cast) the data into the appropriate type for the specialized receiver and perform whatever processing is neccesary for the type of data. An example is as follows: 
      

if (data instanceof LineChartData)
	logger.info(((LineChartData)data).toString());
else if (data instanceof LineChartDefinition)
	logger.info(((LineChartDefinition)data).toString());
else
	logger.warning("unrecognized object received");
return false;
      Parameters:
      data - data object received via the UDP
      Returns:
      true if the receiver is to stop/close its operation, false otherwise.
